description: Joint application for the erection of a part single, part two storey infill rear extension to No. 15 and part upper ground floor rear infill extension to No. 17.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (10 204 102a; 10 204 101a  Received:  01 March 2021;  10 204 201; 10 204 202 (x2)  Received:  09 November 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the part single, part two storey infill rear extension and part upper ground floor rear infill extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the completion of construction works, the 1.7 metre high side privacy screening panel hereby approved shall be fixed to the north western side of No. 15 Cambridge Road North's approved roof terrace, to face No. 13 Cambridge Road North, and be permanently retained as such.
